'''2009 Bespin Regionals Nick Swedal LS Local Uprising (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Swedal]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-11-Local_Uprising-remaster.webp|label=Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' deck2
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
